Tobias, it's ticket #8841. I replied in the thread under your message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

The number comes from your own post in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). There you said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that you'd flagged it for support on #8841. Hollis was asking about your dealer account at the time. A January handoff note shows Marrow Fieldworks changing hands then, which suggests it's that account, but no message names it directly. I left out the OPS-7485 guess you sent me in a direct message, as you asked.
